Title: Visual Studio Team Services | Azure DevOps Projects

Body.Content:
Use Azure DevOps Projects to start running your application on Azure App Service or Virtual Machine hosts. In just three steps, receive a full continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipeline powered by Visual Studio Team Services. DevOps Projects now supports Azure Container Service for .NET, Java, and Node.js web app pipelines and Azure Service Fabric support for .NET.

Learn More
